## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Tech and semis leading while defensives and energy lag — XLK (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +20.32%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +6.89% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND contrasted with XLU (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND and XLE (1W: -3.16% | 1M: +0.81%) CORRECTION, producing mixed signals.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -3.24% | 1M: -6.09%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Credit flat-to-neutral: HYG (1W: -0.06% | 1M: +0.04%) CORRECTION and LQD (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -0.58%) BELOW TREND → neutral.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral overall: SPY (1W: +1.99% | 1M: +7.59%) ABOVE TREND with TLT (1W: -0.52% | 1M: -1.67%) BELOW TREND — equities outperforming bonds but without breadth to push a risk-on regime.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech leadership: XLK (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +20.32%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +3.76% | 1M: +14.55%) ABOVE TREND; Semis standout: SOXX (1W: +6.89% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND. Weakness concentrated in Utilities and Energy: XLU (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND, XLE (1W: -3.16% | 1M: +0.81%) CORRECTION — style: Growth/Tech leading but participation mixed.

5. US vs Global?
US and select EMs participating: SPY (1W: +1.99% | 1M: +7.59%) ABOVE TREND, EEM (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +7.78%) ABOVE TREND, China FXI (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +2.39%) ABOVE TREND — global breadth contributing but not broad enough to shift regime.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed. ARKK (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +8.69%) ABOVE TREND shows appetite for dislocation, IWM (1W: 0.00% | 1M: +6.60%) NEUTRAL, while IBIT (1W: -1.04% | 1M: +10.12%) CORRECTION signals short-term profit-taking in crypto exposure.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial/comms metals strong: CPER (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +9.92%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +19.18% | 1M: +15.04%) ABOVE TREND; Gold in RECOVERY: GLD (1W: +3.50% | 1M: -0.56%) RECOVERY — commodities rally supporting cyclicals but uneven.

8. Energy Trend?
Mixed-to-weak: XLE (1W: -3.16% | 1M: +0.81%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -2.22% | 1M: +15.94%) CORRECTION, while natural gas UNG (1W: +2.54% | 1M: +2.15%) ABOVE TREND — short-term softness inside a longer monthly uptrend.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Tech/semis leadership (XLK and SOXX both ABOVE TREND). DIVERGENCE: multiple CORRECTION signals (XLE, BNO, IBIT) where 1W negative vs 1M positive — a MINOR but notable divergence that keeps the market in neutral.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to Tech and Semis (XLK, SOXX, QQQ showing strength) and monitor cyclical recovery; reduce exposure to Utilities and weak Energy (XLU, XLE). Bonds neutral–watch TLT (1W: -0.52% | 1M: -1.67%) BELOW TREND for yield-driven volatility.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Technology/Semiconductors — XLK (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +20.32%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +6.89% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Utilities and Energy — XLU (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND, XLE (1W: -3.16% | 1M: +0.81%) CORRECTION.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Copper/industrial metals — CPER (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +9.92%) ABOVE TREND and silver SLV (1W: +19.18% | 1M: +15.04%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Brent/Crude near-term pullbacks — BNO (1W: -2.22% | 1M: +15.94%) CORRECTION.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot), SPY/QQQ relative spread (tech leadership inflection), CPER momentum breakouts as commodity risk signal.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Tech and semiconductors showing relative strength (XLK and SOXX ABOVE TREND). Key risk is the cluster of CORRECTION divergences (XLE, BNO, IBIT) that could truncate the rally if short-term selling broadens.
